info.name: Multi-Tenancy API (BETA) BinExplode User Reports API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of message groups to return. If the value exceeds the maximum, then the maximum value will be used.

params.name: reported_at[gte]
params.description: Inclusive start datetime filter for time of report, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z'). Only reports at or after this time will be returned.

params.name: reported_at[lt]
params.description: Exclusive end datetime filter for time of report, in UTC using the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-03-14T15:09:26Z'). Only reports before this time will be returned.
